_help: vans = the configurations to compare; active = id of the van that is packed and shown. interior = [length, width, height] cm (minimum load space from the rental spec), payloadKg = rated payload (already includes a 75 kg driver), passengerKg = everyone else in the cab, subtracted from every van's payload. door = rear door opening [width, height] cm. obstacles = wheel arches etc. with pos [x, y, z] and dims [L, W, H] cm.

vans.name: 1 · Koffer 3.5 t mit Ladebordwand (gebucht)
vans.note: Rental spec, minimum load space: 4370 × 2100 × 2250 mm, payload 815 kg, loading edge 1000 mm high, tail lift available. Box body = flat floor, no wheel arches inside. Door opening not in the spec: assumed 200 × 215 cm.

vans.name: 2 · VW Crafter 3.5 t lang (Fahrtenschreiber + AHK)
vans.note: Rental spec (minimum): load floor 4.30 m, width 1.79 m, height 1.96 m, loading edge 0.77 m, payload 1079 kg, outside 6.97 × 2.43 (mirrors) × 2.62 m. Door and wheel arches not in the spec: door assumed 158 × 182 cm (Crafter high roof), arches assumed 90 long × 20 deep × 33 high, centred ~1.1 m in front of the rear door (138 cm between them).
